clause.title: LAST WILL AND TESTAMENT OF {{personal.full_name}}
clause.declaration: I, {{personal.full_name}}{{frag:relation}}{{frag:age}}{{frag:occupation}}{{frag:residence}}{{frag:id}}, do hereby declare this to be my LAST WILL AND TESTAMENT, made on this {{today.day}} day of {{today.month}}, {{today.year}} at ____________________.
clause.soundmind: I declare that I am of sound mind, memory and understanding, and that I make this Will voluntarily, of my own free will, without any coercion, fraud or undue influence from any person.
clause.revocation: I hereby revoke all Wills and Codicils heretofore made by me, and declare this to be my last Will.
clause.funeral.burial: I desire and direct that my body be buried at {{frag:place}}{{frag:rites}}.
frag.burial.place.mosque: the burial ground (qabristan) of the mosque my family selects
frag.burial.place.church: the cemetery of the church my family selects
frag.burial.place.public: a public burial ground near my residence
frag.burial.place.practical: a place convenient to my family
frag.burial.rites.customs: , with the customary rites of my faith
frag.burial.rites.simple: , with a simple ceremony and without elaborate ritual
clause.funeral.cremation: I desire and direct that my body be cremated at {{frag:place}}{{frag:rites}}.{{frag:ashes}}
frag.crem.place.practical: a place convenient to my family
frag.crem.rites.customs: , with the customary rites of my faith
frag.crem.rites.simple: , with a simple ceremony and without elaborate ritual
frag.crem.ashes.immerse_at: My ashes shall be immersed at {{funeral.cremation.ashes_place}}.
frag.crem.ashes.immerse: My ashes shall be immersed as my family sees fit.
frag.crem.ashes.scatter_at: My ashes shall be scattered at {{funeral.cremation.ashes_place}}.
frag.crem.ashes.scatter: My ashes shall be scattered at a place my family selects.
frag.crem.ashes.kept: My ashes shall be kept by my family.
clause.funeral.donation: I desire and direct that my body be donated for medical education or research{{frag:institution}}. If the donation cannot be accepted for any reason, {{frag:fallback}}
frag.donation.institution.executor: , to an institution my Executor selects
frag.donation.fallback.burial: the burial directions below shall apply.
frag.donation.fallback.cremation: the cremation directions below shall apply.
frag.donation.fallback.family: my family shall decide the arrangements.
clause.funeral.family_decides: I desire that the arrangements for my remains be as my family decides.
clause.funeral.memorial: As to any memorial, I wish for {{frag:memorial}}.
frag.memorial.customs: observances according to the customs of my faith
frag.memorial.simple: a simple gathering, without formal ceremony
clause.muslim: I am aware that under the Muslim personal law applicable to me, bequests exceeding one-third of my net estate, and bequests in favour of my legal heirs, take effect only with the consent of my heirs. The bequests in this Will are intended to operate within that rule, and to the extent any bequest exceeds it, it shall take effect only so far as my heirs consent after my death; the remainder of my estate shall devolve upon my heirs in accordance with that law.
clause.general.single: This Will is executed in a single original. Any photocopy or draft shall not be treated as my Will. If any provision of this Will is held invalid, the remaining provisions shall continue in full force.
clause.testimonium: IN WITNESS WHEREOF I, {{personal.full_name}}, have signed this Will on this {{today.day}} day of {{today.month}}, {{today.year}} at ____________________, in the joint presence of the witnesses below, who have attested it in my presence and in the presence of each other.
clause.attestation: ATTESTATION: Signed by the above-named Testator as the Testator's Last Will and Testament in our joint presence, and signed by us as witnesses in the Testator's presence and in the presence of each other, all being present at the same time. We believe the Testator to be of sound mind, memory and understanding.
clause.executor.physical: I appoint {{person:executors.physical.primary}} as the Executor of this Will.{{frag:secondary}}
frag.executor.physical.secondary: If they are unable or unwilling to act, I appoint {{person:executors.physical.secondary}} as Executor in their place.
clause.executor.digital: I appoint {{person:executors.digital.primary}} as my Digital Executor, to deal with my digital assets and online accounts as directed in this Will, and I direct my Executor to extend all necessary cooperation and authority to them.{{frag:secondary}}
frag.executor.digital.secondary: If they are unable to act, {{person:executors.digital.secondary}} shall act in their place.
clause.executor.powers: My Executor shall have full power to collect and realise my assets, to sell or convert any asset where necessary to give effect to this Will or to pay debts, to sign all documents, to engage professional assistance, to compromise claims, and to do all things necessary for the administration of my estate.{{frag:notes}}
clause.executor.compensation.none: My Executor shall receive no remuneration for acting as Executor, but shall be reimbursed all reasonable expenses incurred in the administration of my estate.
clause.executor.compensation.fixed: My Executor shall be paid {{inr:executors.compensation_amount}} from my estate for acting as Executor.
clause.executor.compensation.reasonable: My Executor shall be entitled to reasonable compensation from my estate for acting as Executor.
clause.debts.first: I direct my Executor to first pay from my estate my funeral expenses, all my just debts, taxes and liabilities, and the costs of administering my estate.
frag.tail.sell: , to be realised and the proceeds added to my residuary estate.
frag.tail.residuary: , to be added to the rest of my estate.
frag.tail.one: to {person} absolutely. If they do not survive me, this bequest shall {contingent}
frag.tail.several: to {names}, {divide}. If any of them does not survive me, their share shall {contingent}
frag.tail.contingent.children: pass to their children in equal shares.
frag.tail.contingent.group.others: be shared equally by the survivors.
frag.tail.life: I give {occupant} the right to reside in and enjoy it for their lifetime, without power of sale, and upon their death it shall pass absolutely to {remainder}.
clause.bank.account: I bequeath the balance in my {{label:item.type}} account with {{item.bank_name}}{{frag:branch}}{{frag:last4}}{{frag:joint}}{{frag:tail}}
frag.bank.account.joint: , to the extent of my share therein
clause.bank.all: I bequeath the balance standing to my credit in all my bank accounts{{frag:tail}}
clause.bank.locker: I bequeath the contents of my locker at {{bank.locker.bank}}{{frag:tail}}
clause.bank.cash: I bequeath any cash held at my residence or otherwise in my possession{{frag:tail}}
frag.re.ownership.share: my share, right, title and interest in
frag.re.action.sell: , to be sold and the net proceeds added to my residuary estate.
frag.re.action.residuary: , to be added to the rest of my estate.
frag.re.rented.continue_tenancy: The existing tenancy shall continue, with rent accruing to the new owner.
frag.re.rented.new_owner_decides: The new owner shall decide on the tenancy.
frag.re.loan: This bequest passes subject to any loan secured on the property being settled by my Executor.
clause.residuary: All the rest and residue of my estate, whether movable or immovable, present or future, including any property not specifically dealt with in this Will and any bequest that fails, I give and bequeath {{frag:primary}}. If none of the above survive me, my residuary estate shall pass to {{frag:contingent}}.
frag.residuary.primary.children: to my children, in equal shares
frag.residuary.primary.spouse_children: to my spouse and children, in equal shares
frag.residuary.contingent.legal_heirs: my legal heirs, in accordance with the law applicable to me
frag.organ.yes_any: I wish to donate all organs and tissues that may benefit others upon my death, and I request my family and physicians to give effect to this wish without delay.{{frag:registered}}
frag.organ.yes_specific: I wish to donate the following upon my death: {{labelList:organ.specific}}, and I request my family and physicians to give effect to this wish without delay.{{frag:registered}}
frag.organ.no: I do not wish to donate my organs.
frag.organ.family_decides: I leave the decision on organ donation to my family.
frag.organ.registered.yes_details: I am a registered organ donor ({{organ.registered_details}}).
frag.organ.registered.yes: I am a registered organ donor.
frag.organ.registered.no: I have not yet registered as an organ donor, though I record this wish here.
clause.guardianship.minors: I appoint {{person:guardianship.primary}} as the guardian of the person of my minor children, in the event my spouse does not survive me or is unable to act.{{frag:alt}}
frag.guardianship.alt: If they are unable or unwilling to act, I appoint {{person:guardianship.alternate}} in their place.
clause.guardianship.property: All property my minor children take under this Will shall be held and applied by {{frag:who}} for their maintenance, education and benefit until each attains the age of {{guardianship.until_age}} years, whereupon the remainder shall be transferred to them absolutely.
clause.guardianship.provision: I direct my Executor to set apart {{inr:guardianship.provision_amount}}{{frag:source}} for the care and benefit of my minor children.
frag.guardianship.source.asset: from the sale of an asset
clause.guardianship.dependent: I direct that {{person:item.person}} be cared for by {{person:item.carer}}. If they are unable to act, {{person:item.alt_carer}} shall do so.{{frag:provision}}{{frag:instructions}}
frag.guardianship.dependent.provision: I direct my Executor to set apart {{inr:item.provision_amount}} for their care.
frag.debts.insured: This is covered by loan insurance; I direct my Executor to first pursue that cover.
frag.debts.strategy.sell_asset: If necessary, the asset securing this debt may be sold to discharge it.
frag.debts.strategy.keep_asset: I direct that the secured asset be preserved and this debt discharged from my other assets so far as possible.
frag.invest.insurance: — the proceeds of this policy are payable to its nominee under insurance law; I direct my Executor to notify the insurer and assist with the claim.
clause.receivables.collect_estate: The sum of {{inr:item.amount}} due to me from {{item.who}} shall be recovered and added to my estate.
clause.receivables.collect_person: The sum of {{inr:item.amount}} due to me from {{item.who}} shall be recovered and paid {{helper:beneficiaryTailOne:}}
clause.receivables.forgive: I forgive and release the debt of {{inr:item.amount}} owed to me by {{item.who}}, and direct that no claim be made in respect of it.
frag.vehicles.loan: This bequest passes subject to any loan secured on it being settled by my Executor.
clause.collect: I bequeath my collections and valuables{{frag:tail}}
clause.jewellery.streedhan: For clarity, jewellery and articles belonging to my spouse are theirs alone and do not form part of my estate.
clause.ip: I bequeath all my rights, title and interest in {{ip.desc}}, including all copyrights, patent rights, trademark rights and related royalties and future income,{{frag:tail}}{{frag:wishes}}
frag.diaries.give_to_person: I bequeath my personal diaries and journals {{helper:beneficiaryTailOne:diaries.action}}
frag.diaries.destroy: I direct my Executor to destroy my personal diaries and journals unread.
frag.diaries.read_first: I direct that {{person:diaries.action.reader}} review my personal diaries and journals first, and decide on their disposal.
frag.diaries.keep_with_family: My personal diaries and journals shall be kept by my family.
frag.diaries.family_decides: The disposal of my personal diaries and journals shall be as my family decides.
clause.diaries.notes: As to my diaries and journals, I further note: {{diaries.notes}}
frag.gadgets.wipe_give_family: My devices shall be wiped of personal data and given to my family.
frag.gadgets.sell: My devices shall be sold, with the proceeds added to my estate.
frag.gadgets.recycle: My devices shall be recycled responsibly.
frag.gadgets.family_decides: The disposal of my devices shall be as my family decides.
frag.gadgets.data.backup_then_wipe: Before any device is given away or sold, its data shall be backed up and then wiped.
frag.gadgets.data.wipe_no_backup: Before any device is given away or sold, its data shall be wiped without backup.
frag.gadgets.data.handed_as_is: My devices may be handed over as-is, with their data intact.
clause.digital.intro: I direct my Executor to deal with my digital assets, accounts and records as follows, to the extent permitted by applicable law and the terms of the relevant services.
frag.digital.subs.cancel_all: My recurring subscriptions and memberships shall be cancelled, and any refunds claimed for my estate.
frag.digital.subs.exceptions: My recurring subscriptions and memberships shall be cancelled, except: {{digital.subs.exceptions}}
frag.digital.subs.family_decides: My family shall decide on my recurring subscriptions and memberships.
frag.digital.statements.full_consent: I authorise my Executor to obtain from any bank or financial institution my statements of account and transaction history.
frag.digital.statements.narrow_consent: I authorise my Executor to obtain my bank statements and transaction history so far as required to close my accounts and settle my liabilities.
frag.digital.social.delete_all: My social media accounts shall be deleted.
frag.digital.social.memorialise: My social media accounts shall be memorialised where the platform permits, and deleted otherwise.
frag.digital.social.archive_then_delete: My social media content shall be downloaded and delivered to {{person:digital.social.recipient}}, and the accounts then deleted.
frag.digital.social.leave_as_is: My social media accounts shall be left as they are.
frag.digital.social.per_platform: My social media accounts shall be dealt with as follows: {{digital.social.notes}}
frag.digital.email.keep_briefly: My email accounts shall be kept accessible for estate administration for a reasonable period, then closed.
frag.digital.email.delete: My email accounts shall be deleted.
frag.digital.email.hand_over: My email accounts shall be handed over to {{person:digital.email.recipient}}.
frag.digital.email.leave_as_is: My email accounts shall be left as they are.
frag.digital.storage.trusted_review: My files and cloud storage shall be reviewed by {{person:digital.storage.reviewer}}, who shall preserve what is of value to my family and delete the rest.
frag.digital.storage.copy_for_family: My files and cloud storage shall be copied and delivered to {{person:digital.storage.recipient}}.
frag.digital.storage.delete_all: My files and cloud storage shall be deleted.
frag.digital.storage.family_decides: My files and cloud storage shall be dealt with as my family decides.
frag.digital.photos.share_with_family: My photographs shall be shared with my family.
frag.digital.photos.one_person: My photographs shall be given to {{person:digital.photos.recipient}}.
frag.digital.photos.review_first: My photographs shall first be reviewed by {{person:digital.photos.reviewer}}, who shall delete what is private.
frag.digital.photos.family_decides: My photographs shall be dealt with as my family decides.
clause.digital.backup: Before any account is closed, the following shall be preserved and delivered to {{person:digital.backup.recipient}}: {{labelList:digital.backup}}.
frag.digital.access.sealed_envelope: Instructions for access are kept in a sealed envelope with my important papers.
frag.digital.access.password_manager: Instructions for access are kept via my password manager's emergency access.
frag.digital.access.trusted_person: Instructions for access are known to {{person:digital.access.person}}.
frag.digital.access.not_set: Instructions for access have not yet been set up; I direct my Executor to make reasonable efforts to locate my accounts.
clause.digital.access.footer: No password or key forms part of this Will.
